info.title: Trajen Portfolio Registry
info.description: Owner-isolated portfolio and asset registry with an immutable ledger and user-recorded manual valuations. See API.md for financial and concurrency semantics. No market-provider calls, FX conversion or dashboards. Financial values are decimal strings. Private responses use Cache-Control: private, no-store. Unknown/read-only body fields are rejected. No DELETE or transaction update methods. POST creation lacks idempotency keys: reconcile unknown outcomes before retrying.
